images.title: Aspect by Tone Heatmap
images.explanation: Shows how extracted ESG aspects are distributed across tone categories. Use it to detect which aspects are dominated by commitment, action, outcome, or other tone classes, and to identify sparse aspect-tone cells.
images.thesis_use: Supports categorization validity, diagnostics for imbalance, and stability discussion across aspect/tone subgroups.

images.title: ClimateBERT Label by Tone
images.explanation: Compares ClimateBERT-style labels against the thesis tone categories. Use it to inspect whether climate labels concentrate in specific tone classes.
images.thesis_use: Supports the ClimateBERT-versus-tone comparison and highlights where label spaces may align or diverge.

images.title: ClimateBERT Remote Top Scores
images.explanation: Summarizes top remote ClimateBERT scores. It is useful as a sanity check, but should be treated as limited evidence unless the scored rows cover the full dataset.
images.thesis_use: Supports preliminary model-output inspection and reproducibility documentation, not final model comparison by itself.

images.title: ESG Pillar by Tone
images.explanation: Shows how Environmental, Social, and Governance categories distribute across tone classes. This helps reveal pillar imbalance and tone asymmetry.
images.thesis_use: Supports claims about ESG pillar coverage and warns where Social or other cells are too sparse for strong conclusions.

images.title: Tone Distribution
images.explanation: Displays the overall distribution of extracted tone labels. Use it as a baseline view of class balance before subgroup or model comparisons.
images.thesis_use: Supports tone-category framing and sample-size reasoning for class balance.

images.title: ABSA Sentiment Confusion Matrix
images.explanation: Confusion matrix for ABSA sentiment predictions. It shows which sentiment classes are correctly predicted and which are confused.
images.thesis_use: Supports model evaluation, error analysis, and diagnostics for sentiment labels.

images.title: Ensemble Sentiment Confusion Matrix
images.explanation: Confusion matrix for an ensemble sentiment output. Compare it with the ABSA matrix to see whether ensembling changes errors or improves stability.
images.thesis_use: Supports ensemble/stability discussion and error comparison across strategies.
